name: torch-placement
comment: Torches (50) placed by set_block (meta 0: BlockTorch.onBlockAdded picks -x, +x, -z, +z, then below) on every side and the top of a stone block at (0, 61, 0), on the platform floor at (3, 61, 3), on a fence (85) at (-4, 61, -4) (canPlaceTorchOn), and in mid-air at (4, 64, 4) (dropTorchIfCantStay drops it at once: an EntityItem, World.rand). The same with redstone torches (76) around a stone block at (0, 61, 5). A redstone torch standing at (3, 61, -3) under a stone block at (3, 62, -3) strongly powers it, so a redstone torch on that block's +x face at (4, 62, -3) turns off two ticks later. At t = 10 the two central blocks are removed (set_block 0): the side and top torches drop (onNeighborBlockChange: meta check or canPlaceBlockAt), the floor ones stay; the redstone torches still schedule their tick (BlockRedstoneTorch.onNeighborBlockChange schedules after super drops them). At t = 20 the fence goes, so its torch drops. ray_trace dumps at t = 5 (torch on the -x face along z, the top torch from above, a ray through the top torch's cell that misses its box and hits the block, a redstone torch, the floor torch) and t = 15 (after the side torch dropped): BlockTorch.collisionRayTrace sets the bounds for the metadata.
